question: What is the name of the women’s wellness space inaugurated by the Department of Legal Affairs, Ministry of Law and Justice in July 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahila Aarogyam Kaksh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Department of Legal Affairs**, under the **Ministry of Law and Justice**, inaugurated a dedicated women’s wellness space titled **Mahila Aarogyam Kaksh** in **July 2025**.
 
• This facility was officially inaugurated by **Dr. Rajiv Mani**, who serves as the **Secretary** of the **Department of Legal Affairs**.
 
• The wellness space is located at **Shastri Bhawan** in **New Delhi**, which houses several important government offices.
 
• The primary **function** of the **Mahila Aarogyam Kaksh** is to provide a dedicated, private, and comfortable environment for **women employees** to manage their health and wellness needs during working hours.
